🌺 Today we fell silent and said "we will remember them."

Remembering has to mean more than two minutes a year. The government's Northern Ireland Troubles Bill cleared the Commons 330 to 178 and is now with the Lords.

⚠️ Even Al Carns, a former Labour defence minister and Royal Marine who served in Northern Ireland, says he's "deeply concerned" it could let lawyers "rewrite history."

Those who served lawfully should not be hounded in old age. 👇
